text:
jonathan: heads up — during the canary of ws-proxy v2 we started seeing duplicate SSE/WS events for some clients, and the console shows per-route token counts doubled for a subset of tenants. billing alarms fired. anyone else?

maya: saw a few alerts. client repro attached — they get the same chat message twice in <1s, looks identical except `route_id` in the trace is sometimes the old one.

jonathan: repro log snippet:```
[2026-10-12T15:04:12Z] recv event id=abc123 body="..." route=ws-proxy-v1
[2026-10-12T15:04:12Z] recv event id=abc123 body="..." route=ws-proxy-v2
```

ashley: deploy-bot shows a rolling restart across 4 pods at 15:03:58 — canary -> stable. :warning: Could this be duplicate delivery during sticky routing handoff?

deploy-bot: user/redwood/ws-proxy rolled to v2. canary instances started at 15:03:50, traffic split 10% -> 50% -> 100% by 15:04:10.

kevin: hmm. two hypotheses: 1) resume-idempotency not being de-duped because resume tokens are looked up in an in-memory cache that gets reset on pod restart, or 2) we temporarily route the same client to both old and new proxy during the rollout due to header-based routing mismatch.

maya: console telemetry also shows counters tagged with both `route=ws-proxy-v1` and `route=ws-proxy-v2` for the same session id. So the tracing header is flipping mid-stream and our aggregation treats them as separate requests (hence doubled token counts).

jonathan: reproduction steps I used:
1) open streaming session to hosted API behind lb with `Prefer: stream=1`
2) start canary rollout `kubectl set image` or via console canary toggle
3) send a prompt that causes ~300 token stream
4) observe duplicate final chunk and doubled token billing in console for that session

kevin: if resume id is the same, the runtime should ignore duplicates. are we propagating resume-id to the model-serving side or only to the proxy? if dropped at proxy restart, model might double-generate.

maya: found proxy logs where `resume-id` header is intermittently missing during handoff:```
E 15:04:12.123 route-change: session=tenant-42:sess-9b resume-id missing, fallback to new session
I 15:04:12.124 deliver: session=tenant-42:sess-9b id=abc123
I 15:04:12.124 deliver: session=tenant-42:sess-9b id=abc123 route=ws-proxy-v2
```

ashley: so likely bug: when a connection is proxied during an in-flight sticky transfer, we don't atomically transfer resume metadata, leading to duplicate emits that both get persisted to telemetry. Also our console aggregation keys are route-scoped, so a single logical session gets split across routes.

jonathan: practical mitigation: revert canary to v1 for now, or pause rollout until we patch atomic resume-transfer + route-aggregation on console. revert safe?

deploy-bot: rollback triggered by @ashley at 15:06:05 — rolling back canary to v1.

kevin: long term fix: 1) make resume-id propagation part of ephemeral session state stored in Redis (shared by old/new proxies) or pass it in the LB sticky metadata, 2) console: aggregate by session id before attributing tokens to route ids, maybe add `session_origin` label.

maya: agree. also add a short-term telemetry flag to count `duplicate_deliveries` so we can detect this in future rollouts automatically.

jonathan: I'll open a short RFC + patch PR: atomic resume transfer + dedupe on intake path. Can someone please capture tcpdump + full proxy logs for the tenant that hit billing? tagging @kevin to collect.

kevin: on it. I'll also add a one-off query in Clickhouse to tag affected invoices and credit them if duplicate confirmed.

ashley: adding incident note to #incidents and will coordinate refunds with finance if needed.

jonathan: thanks. action items:
- kevin: collect logs/tcpdump + clickhouse query (ETA 2h)
- maya: add telemetry counter + temporary alert (ETA 1h)
- jonathan: RFC + PR for resume-transfer (ETA EOD)
- ashley: verify rollback fully resolved duplicates and follow up with billing ops

maya: small thing — add a test harness that simulates rolling restarts and verifies no double-delivery at the proxy layer. saved us before.

jonathan: yep. will include integration test in the PR.

kevin: confirmed I have the tenant id and started debug capture. will post logs in this thread when done. :mag_right:
